title: session_set payload
description: Payload for the viewer session `session_set` surface. Replaces the whole session with the supplied Views. Each item IS a View; the session validates it with the same rules as open_view.

views.description: The canonical open-View set. Deduped by View.id (first position wins, last value wins).

focused.description: Id of the View to mark focused. Ignored if it does not match a supplied View.
